comment: The function hosts Rider run configurations start, and the ports ufw lets the apim container reach.
This is exactly the set loady-one/backend/backend.ps1 starts, in its order: the five default
hosts, then the public ones behind --public (-IncludePublic there).
Loady.Reports.Api and Loady.Imports.Api are deliberately absent. backend.ps1 does not start
them, and Loady.Imports.Api has no local.settings.json, so it has no local configuration to
'wait' records the historical stagger from backend.ps1. Rider compounds start concurrently;
keep the value here as evidence for diagnosing a cold-start race if one reappears.
